inner_arch: In Hypatia the change of language regards not words, but things: every noble architectural signifier promises a familiar courtly, scholarly, or solemn signified under the traveler's old lexicon, yet unsealing each locus exposes its radial ontological inversion—until the traveler rewires the grammar of things and climbs to the dry zenith of the citadel pinnacle to await a ship where no sea exists ('Signs form a language, but not the one you think you know').

anti_trude_vector.medium: Interactive Semiotic Refraction Codex & Split-Plane Architectural Prism with Procedural Canvas Elevations and WebAudio Flute-Harp / Quarry-Chain / Sky-Rigging Synthesis

stones.surface_signifier: Magnolia garden & blue lagoons reflecting white blossoms
stones.expected_signified: Young and beautiful ladies bathing among reflected hedges
stones.inverted_reality: At the lagoon bottom lie suicides with basalt stones tied to their ankles, reef crabs biting their eyes
stones.rewired_grammar: Magnolia lagoon -> Abyssal floor of stone-weighted suicides

stones.surface_signifier: Porphyry steps, highest domes, six tiled fountain courtyards & iron-barred frescoed hall
stones.expected_signified: Imperial audience before the Sultan upon his throne
stones.inverted_reality: Convicts in black iron chains hoisting blocks of black basalt from an underground quarry beneath the palace
stones.rewired_grammar: Porphyry palace & frescoes -> Subterranean basalt convict quarry

stones.surface_signifier: Great library of vellum papyri & vanished alphabets across stairs and bridges
stones.expected_signified: Venerable philosopher consulting ancient scrolls in quiet study
stones.inverted_reality: Dull-eyed youth smoking an opium pipe on a mat points outside the window to the philosopher sitting on a children's swing-garden lawn throwing wooden ninepins
stones.rewired_grammar: Vellum library -> Opium haze pointing to ninepins in the children's garden

stones.surface_signifier: Vaulted stables of the Sultan hung with leather saddles and stirrups
stones.expected_signified: Grooms tending Arabian war-steeds and royal mounts
stones.inverted_reality: Beautiful women with flowing hair and bare legs in riding breeches mounting saddles on trestles with amorous frenzy
stones.rewired_grammar: Sultan's stables -> Women in riding breeches mounting saddles in amorous frenzy

stones.surface_signifier: Cypress necropolis of carved marble tombs and sepulchers
stones.expected_signified: Mourning, dust, and funereal silence of the dead
stones.inverted_reality: Hidden flute and harp musicians inside the tombs answering from grave to grave with sweet living melodies
stones.rewired_grammar: Cemetery tombs -> Sweet flute & harp concerts echoing grave to grave

stones.surface_signifier: Highest pinnacle of the crag citadel high above dry inland stone
stones.expected_signified: Landlocked stone watchtower scanning arid ridges far from any harbor
stones.inverted_reality: Waiting at the very top where no sea exists for a sailing ship to pass overhead and bear the traveler away
stones.rewired_grammar: Dry citadel pinnacle -> Embarkation dock for the sky-ship where no sea exists
